outcome: Neonatal neurological outcomes (cranial neurosonography findings, germinal matrix hemorrhages, intraventricular hemorrhage, cerebral palsy, early neurodevelopmental outcomes)
cohort: 400 pregnant women at imminent risk of preterm delivery (28-34 weeks gestation) who received intravenous magnesium sulfate, studied over two years in a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Antenatal administration of magnesium sulfate between 28 and 34 weeks gestation was safe and effective in improving early neurodevelopmental outcomes among preterm infants, associated with a reduced risk of germinal matrix hemorrhage and a favorable neurological prognosis.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight (VLBW) and low birth weight (LBW)
